baseline_summary: tests 153, suites 31, pass 153, fail 0, cancelled 0, skipped 0, todo 0 (about 1.8 s); re-run unchanged after every fifth variant: always exit 0, 153/153
hash_command: cd <repo> && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs shasum | shasum
notes: R-1.9 and R-3.2 share one variant and one observable (GET after unassign reads null); they are counted as two conditions because the spec states them twice.
R-1.12 ran two variants (message no longer names the record; non-string assignee loads as null); both were killed. The first is the primary patch, the second is under extra_variants.

R-8.14 variant is type-specific (a failed ticket.assigned delivery is recorded as sent): it is the only way to violate the condition for assignment events alone; the generic worker rule is covered for other event types by test/worker.test.js.
R-6.7 is a cross-requirement condition (R-2 trimming x R-6 no-op); R-2.9 uses array/object values because numbers and booleans are R-4.10/R-4.11.
Time-dependent witnesses use real sleeps (20-30 ms) because the service has no clock setting through the environment.
Every variant was run through the suite at least once; a failing suite was re-run once more (and a third time if the second passed). No flaky kill occurred (all failing variants failed twice).
